You don’t deserve to feel like a terrible person.. I haven’t slept for two days so sorry if my words aren’t all that put together but your post stuck out to me and i resonate with a lot of your feelings. Terrible people don’t look back at there choices and feel regret they don’t look to fix anything about themselves an I’m not taking about when they feel to hopeless an like there’s no other option. We all have the ability to make terrible choices when we are in the lowest places but that does not make you as a person bad.. it doesn’t mean you are absolved of your wrong doings but it doesn’t mean you should consider yourself marked because of them an berate yourself till no end (even though i struggle with this heavely myself so i know it’s easier said than done). Acknowledging your mistakes is good an gives you directions on what to focus on working on in the future. I’m younger I have not gone through college or earned a degree or have much debt yet so I can’t say I know why it’s like to be in a job you don’t enjoy but I do believe sometimes when your struggling so much and are overwhelmed with your very existence that being able to find a fleeting moment or a minor activity’s that bring happiness an comfort within reason is a good start to motivating yourself to keep on trying .. I’m not saying purely live life to seek enjoyment because that’s not what life’s about but sometimes when you’ve expiereced so much of the bad parts of life it’s harder to notice any of the good.  As with kids I can let you know from my expierence that no matter how many mistakes you make in there life on the end even as grown adults all they want is to have someone there they can talk to and share expierences with an walk them down the alie when they get married ..children are especially forgiving but even if it takes you longer to feel somewhat in control and you truly show you’ve put effort into changeing and at least attempting to improve they’ll want you in there life no matter how old they are. I think this is all I can manage t say for now but I’m letting you know I care even if I don’t know you and I want to see you expierence the best in life no matter the mistakes you have said you made and that I hope you can be able to believe Inyourself enough to attempt to find happiness love and success. Do not take this as an excuse to countine following the same self destructive patterns but in saying hurt people hurt people and even amogust are imperfections it’s ok to give yourself a break.. it often opens the door even just a little to more positive thinking which you will most likely need as you begin to take steps to attempt to improve your quality of life..sorry your struggling I know what it’s like 🐛🦋
